complaint_text: I received a call from someone claiming to be from my bank SBI. They said my account was about to be blocked and asked me to share my OTP. I shared it and immediately ₹45000 was debited from my account.

I got an SMS saying my account will be suspended. It had a link. I clicked it and entered my net banking credentials. Now my account shows unauthorized transactions of ₹30000.
I received an email from what looked like my bank asking me to verify my account by clicking a link. I clicked and entered my details. Later found ₹15000 missing.
I applied for a job online. They sent me an offer letter and asked for a registration fee of ₹2500 via UPI. After payment they asked for more fees and then stopped responding.
I found a job offer on WhatsApp for data entry work from home. They said I need to pay ₹5000 security deposit which will be refunded. I paid but never got any work or refund.
